why: RJ-F12, pending LO-5 (flare/lottie-open): named .jobs.pending.json so the harness skips it, and renamed to open-recolour-lottie.jobs.json once LO-3 opens .json through FlareLottieOpen and LO-5 turns the open on. Opens bounce.json (a ball shape layer with three position keys over a solid floor), sets the ball's fill to orange and exports Lottie. The input's bytes must be unchanged (Save never targets the JSON); LO-5 pins the exported file's keyframe count and fill colour.
